scope: All61 assigned exact comparisons, full source contexts and selected before/after prose inspected; condition-specific local official evidence and whole-grid metadata preserved. Fixed anchors and outcome-selected supplements remain distinct.
limits: Illustrative selected cases do not estimate frequency or prevalence.
Native bridge/role matching and first-ranked arithmetic recovery do not certify all surrounding prose.
Chain credits first ranked extracted integer; lower-ranked/near numerals are diagnostics only.
Prior-parent effects are separated from new deletion or editing effects. A selected output can retain an eligible unchanged parent.
Only supplied benchmark context and official evidence reviewed; no external factual adjudication or official verdict rewrite.
